definition: a song I had known for years landing differently once I read what it was about

settled:
A song I had heard over a dozen times, across twenty years of living with suicidal ideation, had its rescue buried just under the surface. I had never seen what it was about. Reading that layer once made it land far harder than it ever had.

It is landing harder this year for a recovery reason. This year I am finally starting to feel alive again.

title: The Song I Had Not Understood
